name: Boosteroid
description: Everything for Boosteroid. Tells ConsoleDeck which game it's streaming, so each game can have its own profile (Boosteroid · Last Epoch): add one from the + menu while the game is in front, or ahead of time from Boosteroid Game…, which offers the games you streamed before; it falls back to the Boosteroid profile, then Default. While Boosteroid is in front it taps Shift when Boosteroid warns of inactivity, so the stream isn't ended. Toggle AFK on a button keeps the Mac awake and taps a random key every few minutes while you are away; on the phone that button counts down to the inactivity kick. Put End Session and Toggle AFK on buttons in the Boosteroid profile, and every game's profile has them.

options.label: End Session
options.note: Quits Boosteroid, which stops the stream on the server. Asks first, since unsaved game progress is lost.

exec: display dialog "End the Boosteroid session? Unsaved game progress is lost." buttons {"Cancel", "End Session"} default button "Cancel" cancel button "Cancel" giving up after 10 with icon caution
if gave up of result then return

options.label: Toggle AFK
options.note: Press to start, again to stop. On the phone the button shows the time left before Boosteroid ends the stream for inactivity. Keeps the Mac awake and taps Shift, Option or Control every 2-5 min while Boosteroid is in front, so a stream left alone isn't ended. Stops by itself when Boosteroid quits.
